title: Implement responsible AI for multimodal content

allowedScope.choice: Use image or multimodal Content Safety harm classification, then apply application thresholds/actions.
allowedScope.configuration: Inspect hate/self-harm/sexual/violence severities; choose appropriate reject/review handling; evaluate false positives and negatives for the workload.
allowedScope.comparison: Safety labels do not automatically enforce custom brand, trademark, symbol, or watermark rules.
allowedScope.judgment: A moderation service should route the returned severity according to explicit policy, rather than treating every nonzero value identically.

excludedObjectives.reason: OCR plus text shielding is a design inference, not a documented end-to-end image shield. Direct image coverage, OCR loss, and bypass behavior require separate verified implementation evidence.

The source set does not prove configurable platform watermark enforcement, complete symbol detection, or brand-use validation. Those guarantees remain unsupported; current packets may teach the limit, not claim the missing capability.

evidence.statement: The Image Content Safety quickstart shows severity values 0, 2, 4, and 6 for harm categories and policy thresholds that determine acceptance or rejection.

locators.heading: ## Analyze images
locators.excerpt:
2. Select a sample image from the panels on the page, or upload your own image.
3. Select **Run test**. The service returns all the categories that were detected, with the severity level for each: 0-Safe, 2-Low, 4-Medium, 6-High. It also returns a binary **Accepted**/**Rejected** result, based on the filters you configure. Use the matrix in the **Configure filters** tab on the right to set your allowed/prohibited severity levels for each category. Then you can run the text again to see how the filter works.

locators.heading: ### What types of media can Azure AI Content Safety classify/moderate?
locators.excerpt:
Our content harm classification models support the moderation of text, images, and multimodal content (images with text + OCR). The protected material, prompt shields, and groundedness detection models work with text content only.
